Add Ivim Health to my research tab

I'm adding Ivim Health to your Research tab. It isn't on your current Low-rated apps list, so the app will research it from scratch.

It looks like a strong fit. Ivim Health is a U.S. telehealth company for weight care and cardiometabolic conditions, based in Columbus, Ohio, and founded in 2021. It's a cash-pay GLP-1 service that prescribes semaglutide and tirzepatide, which is the same space as our live client, MyWellness App. Revenue estimates I found online disagree: one says about $14M with 125 staff, another about $21M with 155 staff. Either way, it's a mid-sized company and not a giant brand.

I couldn't confirm whether they have their own patient app, so look for that in the brief.
